scope: Public reports and research about actual AI and agent use; no original interviews or product experiments

evidence: 用途：回答问题76.0%；图片/视频47.8%；文本37.6%；工作总结/会议纪要/PPT32.5%；生活助手30.6%；娱乐30.1%；代码10.8%。

sources.data_period: Late 2025 through early 2026, as described in limitations
sources.read_scope: Full public HTML article and limitations; PDF appendix not retrieved
evidence: API sample n=998481 tool calls; software engineering accounts for nearly50%.
Human interruption reasons include providing missing technical context or corrections32%; agent stop reasons include gathering diagnostic information or test results21% and clarifying requests13%.
sources.limits: Tool calls are not users, deployments, completed tasks, or market share. Coding can generate many calls per task. Interrupt reasons have separate selected-sample denominators.

evidence: Single primary agent use case: customer service26.5%, research and data analysis24.4%, internal workflow automation18%.

sources.data_period: 2025-12 interviews, also identified retrospectively in S3
sources.read_scope: Full public HTML article, examples and limitations
evidence: 80508 volunteer personal-account users; examples include a delivery driver starting an e-commerce business, a landscaper building a music app, and an accountant building a financing-task tool.
Among users explicitly mentioning productivity effects,48% mentioned expanded scope and40% speed.
sources.limits: Volunteer self-reports, inferred occupations and categories, no independent timing. Percentages do not apply to all80508 respondents.
